⚽ Late to training

Coach says: "Late again? 3 laps of the pitch!" The pitch is 100 m by 64 m.

How far do you run?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

One lap = perimeter

100 + 64 + 100 + 64 = 328 m

Step 2

3 laps

3 × 328 = 984 m

984 m. Nearly a kilometre. Set an alarm! ⏰

RECTANGLES

Perimeter in cm. Area in cm².

🏠 Menu

📋 Formulas for 2-D shapes

Learn these. Use them on every question.

⬛ Rectangle

Area = l × w

Perimeter = 2 × (l + w)

◼ Square (s = side)

Area = s × s

Perimeter = 4 × s

▱ Parallelogram (b = base, h = height)

Area = b × h

🔺 Triangle (b = base, h = height)

Triangle area =

b × h

2

⏢ Trapezium (a, b = parallel sides)

Trapezium area =

(a + b) × h

2

🧩 Compound shape

Split it. ADD or SUBTRACT the areas.

Q3

Calculator

[4 marks] Medium

£4.50 per m²

£9 per metre

Is the budget enough?

Tarmac for this car park costs

£4.50 per m²

. A fence round the edge costs

£9 per metre

. The budget is £18 000.

Is the budget enough?

1. Tarmac

Tarmac = area × £4.50

80 × 45 × 4.5

£16 200

= £16 200

M1

2. Fence

Fence = perimeter × £9

2 × (80 + 45) × 9

£2250

= £2250

M1

3. Total

16 200 + 2250

£18 450

Total = £18 450

A1

4. Decide

18 450 > 18 000 →

No

More than £18 000: No

B1

Check: 3600 × 4.5 = 16 200 and 250 × 9 = 2250 ✓

Marks: M1 M1 A1 B1 = 4

Common slip: Yes. That uses the area for the fence.
